basic_details.short_information: Hathras District Court has released a recruitment notification to re-engage retired employees on 89 temporary posts for a duration of one year. The application mode is strictly offline. Register for Job Alerts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application format (Proforma-I and Proforma-II) from the notification document.
Fill in all required details, affix a self-attested passport-size photograph, and attach the Last Pay Certificate and last Pension Certificate.
Enclose a self-attested affidavit stating that no criminal case is pending, under trial, or resulting in conviction in any court.
Submit the completed application form by hand at Prashasanik Karyalay, Janpad Nyayalay, Hathras.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 28 October 2026 by 4:00 PM.

content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application format (Proforma-I and Proforma-II) from the notification document. Fill in all required details, affix a self-attested passport-size photograph, and attach the Last Pay Certificate and last Pension Certificate. Submit the completed application form by hand at Prashasanik Karyalay, Janpad Nyayalay, Hathras. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 28 October 2026 by 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is Hathras District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Hathras District Court Recruitment 2026 is an engagement process for retired employees to fill 89 temporary posts of Stenographer, Group III, and Group IV on a one-year tenure.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 89 total vacancies announced under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 28 October 2026 up to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed 65 years of age or more cannot apply for these posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary is determined by subtracting the current pension amount from the last drawn pay.
